name: grid-fragment-spanning-item-continuation
derivation: Column 1 spans two fixed rows of 29px and 31px, with no gap: its stretched allocation is 60px. Its sole 60px-tall child also crosses the break. Column 2 has one item in each row; the second forces a page break exactly at the first 29px frame's end. The spanning item and child each consume 29px on page 1, leaving 60-29=31px on page 2 at y47. Each must publish exactly two rectangles, not be restarted or published again when the second row is scheduled. The column-2 row items each publish one rectangle at x41, with widths 82px. Both grid fragments exactly fill their respective 29px and 31px frames.
